title: Hear Thanks, Then Meet Six Signs
label: ch:thanks-script-a
canDo: I can understand and say dhanyavad before decoding it, then write six new Devanagari signs one at a time through visible, guided, and delayed work.

payoff.summary: Write dental ta after a delay while keeping the first five signs separately retrievable.
payoff.note: Meaning arrives first; every script lesson adds at most one sign and remains below five minutes.
